text:
```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Create PPA repository (if not already created)
        run: |
          echo "deb http://ppa.launchpad.net/jdx/mise/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mise.list
          sudo apt-key adv --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys 0xYOUR_PPA_KEY_HERE

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y dpkg-dev debhelper

      - name: Package project
        run: cargo deb

      - name: Upload package to PPA
        run: dput ppa:jdx/mise target/*.changes

      - name: Free up disk space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          input: tool-cache
```
